findings.reason: a consolidation that fixes three of five readers leaves two dead resolutions against the same machinery, so the "one owner" done-when is met while the defect survives; the inventory must include server.py:827 and schema_context.py:95 (or state why they are out of scope).
findings.text: §19 asserts "the three readers resolve a chunk's source" and consolidates exactly those three, but `_search_code_chunks` at llm/server.py:827 reads `OPTIONAL MATCH (sf:CodeFile)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(node)` and returns `sf.path AS source_file`, and imas_codex/graph/schema_context.py:95 emits the same `MATCH (cf:CodeFile)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(node)`; the schema declares CodeFile-[:HAS_EXAMPLE]->CodeExample-[:HAS_CHUNK]->CodeChunk (facility.yaml CodeFile block has only AT_FACILITY/IN_DIRECTORY/HAS_EXAMPLE; CodeExample owns has_chunks), and the sole writer (ingestion/pipeline.py:522) MERGEs the CodeExample edge — so both sites return a null source_file on a live path and are not touched by the plan

findings.reason: the plan should add expanded_at to PATH_RESET_SPECS clear_fields (extending the owner) and/or say why the seed must own the clear, otherwise the reset path the plan cites as "facility-wide, no --reset-to involved" remains silently unable to re-expand.
findings.text: §14 fixes re-expansion by having seed_facility_roots write `expanded_at: null` into its `SET n += item` map, but the owner of making a FacilityPath reprocessable is PATH_RESET_SPECS / reset_to_status in discovery/base/reset.py (driven by `discover paths --reset-to`), whose clear_fields for "triaged" and "scanned" do NOT include expanded_at — so the plan forks a second clearing site and `--reset-to scanned|triaged` still cannot re-expand an already-expanded path

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §19 consolidates the resolution behind one parameterised helper instead of a wrapper per site, and §14 extends an existing function by one key; neither adds shallow surface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14 adds a SECOND site that clears a FacilityPath lifecycle stamp, beside the shared reset owner that already owns FacilityPath state fields.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §19 states its budget and names the merge it performs ("all three sites embed it, find_code's dead arm goes with it"), and §14 adds no CLI option, MCP view, refusal family or public definition.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §19's reader inventory is incomplete: it names three chunk→source readers but two more resolve the same quantity via an undeclared edge, and are left unfixed.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the §19 helper is justified by three divergent readers it replaces (find_code's dead arm is retired with it) and §14 extends the existing seed branch rather than wrapping it.
